g.text: Handles selection bias from only observing approved applicant outcomes
Infers outcomes for rejected applicants → produces weighted dataset for unbiased model training
Removes low-quality features: high nulls, zero variance, non-numeric columns
Logs every dropped feature with reason → triggers DATA_QUALITY_001 if too many dropped
Classifies each feature by cardinality to guide downstream binning strategy
ID-like features flagged for review · type metadata passed to binning stage
Decision-tree optimal splits → WoE encoding → IV filtering, monotonicity & PSI checks
Logs bin boundaries, WoE values, event rates, IV, monotonicity direction & PSI level per feature
Hierarchical clustering (1−|corr|) → picks best representative per cluster → p-value filter
univariate sm.Logit per representative (p < 0.05 to keep)
Forward-backward stepwise: LR test for entry, Wald test for removal, AUC tracking per step
patience=5 steps · monitors test AUC · restores best state
Prevents overfitting by halting when test AUC plateaus → FEATURE_SELECTION_001 trigger if empty
Discovers meaningful feature interactions (X₁·X₂, X₁/X₂, X₁−X₂) that improve predictive power
min AUC improvement + p-value + correlation filter
max_interactions=5 · tests all candidate pairs → keeps those meeting AUC & significance thresholds
Last statistical gate: ensures all surviving features are significant and independent
Unregularized logistic regression → scorecard conversion → SQL generation → bootstrap CIs
Outputs deployment-ready SQL · triggers MODEL_TRAINING_001 on fit failure
Ongoing monitoring: stability tracking, segment analysis, and champion/challenger comparison

svg.text: All stages produce JSON-serializable logs for web frontend visualization
Plotly (interactive) + Matplotlib (static) · Warm color scheme · SaaS trigger mechanism
